plugins.name: storytelling
plugins.description: Creative writing and worldbuilding companion backed by an Obsidian vault. Invents and pressure-tests characters, worlds, cultures, groups, religions, magic and tech systems, and plots — then writes the prose, in each world's own language. Invoke with /Storytelling or just describe the fiction you are building.
